channel.title: UK Defence Journal - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from UK Defence Journal (ukdefencejournal.org.uk)

item.title: Britain should double its reserve forces
item.description: Steve Barclay MP, former Cabinet minister and MP for North East Cambridgeshire, argues that expanding UK reserves offers one of the most cost-effective ways to strengthen national defence and access specialist skills. The post Britain should double its reserve forces first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: MP warns British naval capability has diminished
item.description: Labour MP Alex Ballinger has warned that the Royal Navy’s surface fleet has sadly diminished, raising concerns about UK ability to meet growing security commitments across multiple theatres. The post MP warns British naval capability has diminished first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: UK explores modular weapon fits for hybrid navy
item.description: The Royal Navy is seeking industry input on new modular weapon pods designed to be compatible with both crewed and uncrewed platforms. The post UK explores modular weapon fits for hybrid navy first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: UK defence exports grow as Europe becomes top market
item.description: European defence spending and major export deals have pushed demand for UK defence equipment higher, according to official statistics. The post UK defence exports grow as Europe becomes top market first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: Downie highlights JEF role in protecting Arctic
item.description: Labour MP Graeme Downie has highlighted the importance of the UK-led Joint Expeditionary Force (JEF) in protecting critical undersea infrastructure in the High North and Arctic during a Westminster Hall debate on NATO and the region. The post Downie highlights JEF role in protecting Arctic first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: Belfast’s new build line at Harland and Wolff
item.description: Inside the new Belfast extension, Harland and Wolff is reorganising how steel moves through the yard, linking stockyard staging, cutting machinery and a 200-metre panel line designed for higher throughput. The post Belfast’s new build line at Harland and Wolff first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: A third UK naval prime anchored in Belfast
item.description: Navantia UK says investment across its four yards is intended to support a "third UK naval prime", combining Belfast integration with design access, group expertise and a broader industrial footprint. The post A third UK naval prime anchored in Belfast first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: Apprenticeships and reskilling in Harland and Wolff rebuild
item.description: With more than 220 apprentices already in training and further recruitment under way, Navantia UK is expanding training, reskilling and outreach as part of rebuilding the workforce behind Belfast’s shipyard revival. The post Apprenticeships and reskilling in Harland and Wolff rebuild first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: Navantia is remaking Harland and Wolff for a new era
item.description: Harland and Wolff's Belfast yard is undergoing a major overhaul under Navantia UK, with new steel-processing lines, upgraded facilities and workforce expansion aimed at supporting Fleet Solid Support and future naval construction. The post Navantia is remaking Harland and Wolff for a new era first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: Britain reveals military repair facilities inside Ukraine
item.description: The UK has revealed for the first time that it is operating a network of military maintenance facilities inside Ukraine to repair battle-damaged equipment. The post Britain reveals military repair facilities inside Ukraine first appeared on UK Defence Journal.
